'''Gom Danvik''' was a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He supplied other hunters with equipment during the war he and was stationed on board the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]]. Gom Danvik wore a [[Color/Legends|green]] and yellow set of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] including a helmet, and worked in the supplies section of the station.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gom Danvik was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as a Basic Gear vendor for the Bounty Hunter class, but with the release of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a second version of Danvik was added as a Classic Token vendor in the same room. Both versions were later removed as vendors and NPCs in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, he remains in the game, as his character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
